getFinanceRecurrences.sheet.subtitle: It books itself every month on the day you choose.
getFinanceRecurrences.sheet.dayHint: From 1 to 31. Shorter months use their last day.
getFinanceRecurrences.sheet.endMonthHint: Leave it empty when it has no end date.
getFinanceRecurrences.sheet.activeHint: Pausing it stops the bookings without losing what was already booked.
